content: I expanded on a fork in https://github.com/Cobord/lean-coxeter but I punted on a few things like making Matsumoto have to be provided rather than a general proof no matter the Coxeter system. There are also a bunch of proof_wanted for the cases of interest for the affine type cases. So if there is anything that could help fill in those proof_wanted that would be much appreciated to getting this into a much more usable state
